intro: Two piano notes play, one after the other. Was the second one higher or lower? Each step you hear makes the next one smaller. Then four short melodies: the same, or different? No microphone, about two minutes.
tip: Headphones or a quiet room help with the smallest steps.
pianoFailed: The piano didn't load. Check your connection and try again.

run.question: Was the second note higher or lower?
run.sameQuestion: Were the two melodies the same?

result.finer: That's finer than the 25 cents Scalita counts as off when you sing a note, so you can hear a note drift before the app would call it off.

result.wider: Next up: steps smaller than {cents}. Ears get finer with practice: in one study, non-musicians caught up with trained musicians after a few hours.
result.none: The semitone steps were hard to tell apart this time. Headphones, a quiet room and another try often change that.
result.cent: 100 cents make a semitone, one piano key to the next.
result.sample: One run is a quick reading, and a little luck is in every answer. Another run will move it a step or so.
result.ctaBody: Scalita's Accuracy Training turns hearing into singing: match notes on a live pitch trail, or sing back leaps from songs, in your own range. Free on Android, no account.
